chunks: And with his chain, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are the best of the people of the Earth after me and after their father, and their mother is the best of the women of the Earth.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ: the people of the Earth / humanity
key_terms.الْحَسَنُ وَالْحُسَيْنُ: Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, the grandsons of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the best people and women on Earth according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt, affirming Hasan and Husayn as the preeminent figures of the Earth following the Prophet and Ali, while elevating Fatimah al-Zahra as the supreme woman. In Shia scholarship, this narration is often cited to establish the spiritual hierarchy of the Imams and the purity of the Prophet's progeny, linking their earthly excellence to their divine selection. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the reverence accorded to the Fourteen Infallibles within the tradition.
